quote: Kuboi 2013 abstract: "The hemagglutinin is a 32-kilodalton protein that shows activity as an L-fucose lectin." UniProt FUNCTION (ECO:0000269): "Mediates binding of A.fumigatus conidia to airway mucin in a fucose dependent manner (PubMed:27058347)."
notes: Role disputed: Sakai 2019 (PMID 29370403, summarised page only) reports no obvious difference in conidial adhesion to cultured cells. In UniLectin3D with 9 PDB entries. Spec F14, F28.

quote: Martinez-Alarcon 2021 abstract: "We finally demonstrated that SapL1 binds to bronchial epithelial cells in a fucose-dependent manner." and "Submicromolar affinity was measured for fucose using isothermal titration calorimetry."
notes: Purified protein only. No knockout. In UniLectin3D (1 PDB entry, alpha-methyl-L-fucoside).

quote: Kar 2019 abstract: "these proteins have the capacity to bind two substrates, chitin and N-linked oligosaccharides associated with human skin glycoproteins." The abstract also says each LysM domain "can bind to chitin, to N-linked oligosaccharides in human skin glycoproteins, and to N-linked oligosaccharides on fungal glycoproteins."
notes: Trichophyton rubrum LysM1 (Onygenales). Not in the spec F-table. LysM is an M2 model. No structure. Caveat: binding is also shown to fungal glycoproteins and chitin, so the glycan binding is not host-specific. The H1a label is a reading of the abstract; the owner decides.

quote: Kar 2019 abstract: "these proteins have the capacity to bind two substrates, chitin and N-linked oligosaccharides associated with human skin glycoproteins." The abstract also says each LysM domain "can bind to chitin, to N-linked oligosaccharides in human skin glycoproteins, and to N-linked oligosaccharides on fungal glycoproteins."
notes: Trichophyton rubrum LysM2 (Onygenales). Not in the spec F-table. LysM is an M2 model. No structure. Caveat: binding is also shown to fungal glycoproteins and chitin, so the glycan binding is not host-specific. The H1a label is a reading of the abstract; the owner decides.

quote: de Jonge 2010 abstract: "Ecp6 sequesters chitin oligosaccharides that are released from the cell walls of invading hyphae to prevent elicitation of host immunity."
notes: Also in UniLectin3D (2 PDB entries).

quote: Marshall 2011 abstract: "Both proteins [Mg3LysM and Mg1LysM] bind chitin" and both "protected fungal hyphae against plant-derived hydrolytic enzymes".
notes: Mg1LysM. Also in UniLectin3D (1 PDB entry).

quote: Marshall 2011 abstract: "Both proteins [Mg3LysM and Mg1LysM] bind chitin; however, only Mg3LysM blocked the elicitation of chitin-induced plant defenses."
notes: Mg3LysM. No structure in the 56-table.

quote: Mentlak 2012 abstract: "Slp1 ... can bind to chitin, and is able to suppress chitin-induced plant immune responses" and "Slp1 competes with CEBiP for binding of chitin oligosaccharides."
notes: Slp1 of Pyricularia oryzae (Magnaporthe oryzae). UniProt accession found by lit_pubmed:22267486.

quote: Takahara 2016 abstract: "recombinant ChELP1 and ChELP2 bind chitin and chitin oligomers in vitro with high affinity and specificity and ... both proteins suppress the chitin-triggered activation of two immune-related plant mitogen-activated protein kinases".
notes: ELP2. UniProt accession mapped by protein name and cited PMID.

quote: Takahara 2016 abstract: "recombinant ChELP1 and ChELP2 bind chitin and chitin oligomers in vitro with high affinity and specificity".
notes: ELP1.

quote: Kombrink 2017 abstract: "this LysM effector [lineage-specific, strain VdLs17] binds chitin, is able to suppress chitin-induced immune responses and protects fungal hyphae against hydrolysis by plant hydrolytic enzymes."
notes: Vd2LysM. That the lineage-specific effector of the abstract is Vd2LysM comes from the UniProt record (gene name Vd2LysM cites PMID 27911046; strain VdLs.17). Not checked in the full text.

quote: Cen 2017 abstract: "Both proteins [Blys2 and Blys5] could bind chitin".
notes: Blys2 of Beauveria bassiana (insect pathogen).

quote: Cen 2017 abstract: "Blys5 (containing two LysM domains) could additionally bind chitosan and cellulose" and "Blys5 could potentially protect fungal hyphae against chitinase hydrolysis."
notes: Blys5 of Beauveria bassiana.

quote: van den Burg 2006 abstract: "Avr4 ... is a chitin-binding lectin containing an invertebrate chitin-binding domain (CBM14)" and "In vitro, Avr4 protects chitin against hydrolysis by plant chitinases."
notes: Avr4 of Fulvia fulva (Cladosporium fulvum). The UniProt FUNCTION text names only the elicitor role. CBM_14 is M2 (spec F24).

quote: Pohleven 2009 abstract: "Glycan microarray analysis revealed that the lectin recognizes human blood group A determinant GalNAcalpha1-3(Fucalpha1-2)Galbeta-containing carbohydrates, and GalNAcbeta1-4GlcNAc."
notes: Clitocybe nebularis lectin (CNL). Not in the 56-table.

quote: UniProt FUNCTION (ECO:0000269, PMID 8999822): "Binds lactose." Abstract of PMID 8999822: "the recombinant C. cinereus galectin shows particular affinity for blood group A structures."
notes: Coprinopsis cinerea galectin-1. The abstract does not say which isolectin was expressed. Tier T2 (Swiss-Prot with ECO:0000269).

quote: Coltri 2006 abstract: "Paracoccin was able to interact with laminin in a dose-dependent manner. This interaction was inhibited by GlcNAc". Alegre 2014 abstract: "The results indicated that paracoccin is the protein encoded by PADG-3347". Alegre-Maller 2014: "PCN binds to N-glycans on TLRs".
notes: Paracoccin, Paracoccidioides brasiliensis (Onygenales). Spec decision D9: no custom model; known gap. UniProt C1G842 is TrEMBL, ORF name PADG_03347, 218 aa. Its Pfam hit in UniProt is PF00704 (Glyco_hydro_18). No paper maps the GlcNAc site (L3b report).

quote: Tian 2021 abstract: "Mgx1LysM binds chitin, suppresses the chitin-induced ROS burst, and is able to protect fungal hyphae against chitinase hydrolysis."
notes: Mgx1LysM of Zymoseptoria tritici. Selected through the PF01476 UniProt cross-reference (model gated).

quote: UniProt FUNCTION (ECO:0000269, PMID 35142828): "Lectin that specifically binds to L-fucose".
notes: Tier T2 by the one rule of LOG decision 12 (Swiss-Prot reviewed, ECO:0000269 sugar-binding statement). The abstract of PMID 35142828 reports a gene deletion phenotype (trap formation) and no binding assay. Selected through the PF07938 UniProt cross-reference (model gated). Arthrobotrys oligospora.

quote: Liu 2023 abstract: "The Cordyceps militaris gene CCM_03832 encodes a ricin-B like lectin ... Glycan array analyses ... showed that CMRBL possesses very high specific binding activity of glycans terminated with type II LacNAc".
notes: CMRBL. UniProt G3JGU5 (TrEMBL) has ORF name CCM_03832, the gene named in the abstract. Found by literature search (review 1), not through a Pfam cross-reference. First positive for PF00652 (ricin-B lectin) on a non-structure row.
